scripts.dev:server: cross-env LOG_SOAP=1 nodemon --watch server --exec "node --loader ts-node/esm server/index.ts"
scripts.dev:buildings: cross-env LOG_SOAP=1 nodemon --watch services/building-info-service --exec "node --loader ts-node/esm services/building-info-service/index.ts"
scripts.dev: cross-env DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=./.env concurrently -k -n client,server,buildings,solar -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:buildings" "npm run dev:solar"
scripts.dev:local: cross-env API_ENV=test concurrently -k -n client,server,buildings,subsidy -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:buildings" "npm run dev:subsidy"
scripts.build: npm run sync:punkt-assets && tsc && vite build
scripts.build:prod: npm run build && npm run build:backend
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:contract && npm run test:smoke
scripts.verify:ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:contract
scripts.test:e2e:live: cross-env LIVE=1 LOG_SOAP=1 node --loader ts-node/esm scripts/test-e2e-building.ts
scripts.test:contract: TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.contract.json node --loader ts-node/esm scripts/test-contract-matrikkel.ts && node --import tsx scripts/test-contract-resultAssembler.ts
